column1: # LUT file (from FilmCamera res/raw) or design:<id> (tools Designer)
# LUT entries: one per film, using the variant that converts most accurately to the camera's curve + matrix.
# Brand order: Polaroid, Ilford, Agfa, Rollei, More film, Kodak, Fujifilm, Cine (designed looks, then cinema prints), Spektrafilm, Moods,
# then Develop (last, so the earlier looks keep their numbers).
# Spektrafilm brand: LUTs baked by tools/spektrafilm/bake.py from spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato (CC BY-SA 4.0).
# Develop brand: LUTs baked by tools/develop/bake.py with Develop's engine (github.com/jegly/Develop), from
# spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato (CC BY-SA 4.0): its measured films plus 93 rebuilt from makers' data sheets.
